title: 建议信：二选一（艺术展 / 机器人展）
point: 建议信范文：二选一的理由展开
structure: 目的句：I am writing to suggest that…
主体：To begin with / In addition / Finally
收尾：I would appreciate it if…

paragraphs.en: Dear David, I am writing to suggest that you go to the art exhibition, and there are three reasons for my recommendation. Both exhibitions sound attractive, but I believe the art show suits you better.
paragraphs.cn: 亲爱的大卫：我写信是想建议你去看艺术展，理由有三。两场展览听起来都不错，但我认为艺术展更适合你。
keys: I am writing to suggest that

paragraphs.en: To begin with, the exhibition offers a rare chance to engage with different cultures. In addition, you can draw creative inspiration from the works on display. Finally, the experience is likely to be far more memorable than the robot show. What is more, the exhibition is free of charge, so it will not add to your budget.
paragraphs.cn: 首先，展览提供接触不同文化的难得机会。其次，你能从展品中获得创作灵感。最后，这段经历很可能比机器人展更令人难忘。此外，展览免费，不会增加你的开销。
keys: To begin with / In addition / Finally
is likely to be far more memorable

paragraphs.en: I would appreciate it if you could take my suggestion into consideration. I am sure you will enjoy it. Yours sincerely, Li Ming.
paragraphs.cn: 如果你能考虑我的建议，我将不胜感激。相信你一定会喜欢。你真诚的，李明。

blanks.en: I am writing to ____ that you ____ to the art exhibition, and there are three reasons for my ____.

To begin with, the exhibition offers a ____ chance to engage with different cultures. In addition, you can draw creative ____ from the works on display. Finally, the experience is ____ to be far more memorable than the robot show.
I would ____ it if you could take my suggestion into ____.

transfer: I am writing to suggest that… 换成 congratulate / apologize / complain 即改题型
To begin with / In addition / Finally 三点式衔接，图表作文写原因同样可用
I would appreciate it if you could… 比 Please… 更礼貌的收尾

title: 道歉信：取消拜访并另约时间
point: 道歉信范文：说明原因 + 提出补救
structure: 道歉句：I am writing to apologize for…
原因与补救：The reason is that… / I wonder if…
再次致歉：Please accept my sincere apology

paragraphs.en: Dear Professor Smith, I am writing to apologize for cancelling our meeting next week and to explain the situation. I feel terribly sorry for the inconvenience this may cause you.
paragraphs.cn: 尊敬的史密斯教授：我写信是为取消下周的会面致歉，并说明情况。由此可能给您带来的不便，我深感抱歉。
keys: I am writing to apologize for

paragraphs.en: The reason is that an innovation contest will be held in my university next week, and I have been asked to lead my team. Therefore, I have to cancel the travel plan. I wonder if we could meet next month instead. I will make up for the lost time as soon as I come back.
paragraphs.cn: 原因是下周学校要举办创新比赛，我被安排带队，因此不得不取消行程。不知我们能否改到下个月见面。我一回来就会把耽误的时间补上。
keys: I wonder if we could meet next month instead

paragraphs.en: Please accept my sincere apology for any inconvenience I have caused. I am looking forward to your reply. Thank you for your understanding. Yours sincerely, Li Ming.
paragraphs.cn: 对由此带来的不便，请接受我诚挚的歉意。期待您的回复。感谢您的理解。你真诚的，李明。
keys: I am looking forward to your reply

blanks.en: I am writing to ____ for cancelling our meeting next week and to ____ the situation.
The ____ is that an innovation contest will be held in my university next week, and I have been asked to ____ my team. I wonder if we could meet next month ____.
Please accept my ____ apology for any inconvenience I have caused. I am looking ____ to your reply.

transfer: I am writing to apologize for… 换成 complain about / apply for 即改题型
The reason is that… 说明原因，投诉信与请假信通用
I wonder if we could… 委婉请求，比 Can you… 更得体

title: 感谢信：文化交流项目的接待
point: 感谢信范文：感谢 + 具体回顾 + 回邀
structure: 感谢句：I am writing to express my sincere thanks
具体回顾：It was … that enabled me to…
回邀：I would be delighted to…

paragraphs.en: Dear Mr. Lee, I have just returned from the United States, and I am writing to express my sincere thanks for your warm reception. Your kindness made my stay both pleasant and unforgettable.
paragraphs.cn: 尊敬的李先生：我刚从美国回来，特此写信感谢您的热情接待。您的热情让我的这趟行程既愉快又难忘。
keys: I am writing to express my sincere thanks

paragraphs.en: It was your patience and enthusiasm that enabled me to learn so much about American culture. The activities you arranged, such as the cultural performance and the museum visit, left a deep impression on me. What impressed me most was your careful arrangement of every detail.
paragraphs.cn: 正是您的耐心与热情让我对美国文化有了如此多的了解。您安排的文化演出、博物馆参观等活动给我留下了深刻印象。最让我印象深刻的是您对每个细节的周到安排。
keys: It was … that enabled me to
left a deep impression on me

paragraphs.en: I would be delighted to welcome you to China in due course. Please give my best regards to your family. I sincerely hope we can meet again in the near future. Yours sincerely, Zhang Wei.
paragraphs.cn: 我也非常乐意在合适的时候欢迎您来中国。请代我向您的家人问好。我真诚希望不久的将来我们能再见面。你真诚的，张伟。
keys: I would be delighted to welcome you
give my best regards to your family

blanks.en: I have just returned from the United States, and I am writing to express my ____ thanks for your warm ____.
It was your patience and ____ that ____ me to learn so much about American culture. The activities you arranged left a deep ____ on me.
I would be ____ to welcome you to China in ____ course.

transfer: I am writing to express my sincere thanks for… 换成 congratulations on… 即祝贺信
It was … that enabled me to… 强调句，写作中可替代 Because of you, I…
I would be delighted to… 正式邀约或表达意愿

title: 通知：夏令营招募志愿者
point: 通知范文：活动介绍 + 职责要求 + 报名方式
structure: 标题与告知：Notice / Attention all students
内容分点：The camp offers… / Volunteers are expected to…
报名与号召：Those who are interested should…

paragraphs.en:
Notice

Attention all students! Our university will host a summer camp for high school students in July, and volunteers are needed. This is a valuable chance to serve others and to develop your abilities.
paragraphs.cn:
通知

各位同学请注意！我校将于七月举办面向高中生的夏令营，现招募志愿者。这是服务他人、锻炼能力的好机会。

paragraphs.en: The camp offers lectures, campus tours and group discussions, which help participants learn about university life. Volunteers are expected to guide the students, organize activities and answer their questions. In addition, volunteers will receive basic training before the camp begins.
paragraphs.cn: 夏令营安排讲座、校园参观和小组讨论，帮助参与者了解大学生活。志愿者需要引导学生、组织活动并答疑。此外，志愿者将在夏令营开始前接受基础培训。

paragraphs.en:
Those who are interested should send an email to camp@example.com before June 20. Welcome to join us! We are looking forward to your active participation.

July 1, 2026
paragraphs.cn:
有意者请于 6 月 20 日前发邮件至 camp@example.com。欢迎加入！期待大家积极参与。

2026 年 7 月 1 日

blanks.en: Our university will ____ a summer camp for high school students in July, and ____ are needed.
The camp offers lectures, campus tours and group discussions, which help ____ learn about university life. Volunteers are ____ to guide the students and ____ activities.
Those who are ____ should send an email to camp@example.com ____ June 20.

transfer: Attention all students! 通知开头句，换成 Attention all members! 同理
Volunteers are expected to… 换成 Applicants are required to… 即改成招募要求
Those who are interested should… 招募与报名类固定句式

title: 投诉信：电子词典质量问题
point: 投诉信范文：投诉 + 事实 + 要求解决
structure: 投诉句：I am writing to complain about…
事实陈述：Unfortunately, … / I have tried…
要求解决：I would like to request…

paragraphs.en: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to complain about the electronic dictionary I bought from your online store last week. The product is still under warranty, so I hope the matter can be settled without delay.
paragraphs.cn: 尊敬的先生或女士：我写信是投诉上周在贵网店购买的电子词典。产品仍在保修期内，希望此事能尽快解决。
keys: I am writing to complain about

paragraphs.en: Unfortunately, the screen stops working after five minutes, which makes the device useless for my study. I have tried charging it again, but the problem remains. I have also contacted your online customer service, but no satisfactory reply has been given.
paragraphs.cn: 遗憾的是，屏幕运行五分钟后就会失灵，使这台设备无法用于学习。我已尝试重新充电，但问题依然存在。我也联系过贵店在线客服，但没有得到满意答复。
keys: I have tried…, but the problem remains

paragraphs.en: I would like to request a replacement or a full refund. I would appreciate it if you could deal with this matter promptly. I look forward to hearing from you soon. Yours sincerely, Zhang Wei.
paragraphs.cn: 我希望换货或全额退款。如能尽快处理此事，我将不胜感激。期待尽快收到您的回复。你真诚的，张伟。

blanks.en: I am writing to ____ about the electronic dictionary I bought from your ____ store last week.
Unfortunately, the screen stops working after five minutes, which makes the ____ useless for my study. I have tried ____ it again, but the problem ____.
I would like to ____ a replacement or a full ____. I would appreciate it if you could deal with this matter ____.

transfer: I am writing to complain about… 换成 inquire about… 即咨询信
Unfortunately, …, which makes… 陈述问题并说明影响
I would like to request… 正式提出诉求，投诉与申请通用

title: 询问信：了解志愿项目细节
point: 询问信范文：表明来意 + 具体问题 + 致谢
structure: 来意：I am writing to inquire about…
具体问题：I would like to know…
致谢：I would be grateful if…

paragraphs.en: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to inquire about the "Aiding Rural Primary School" project mentioned on your website. I am a sophomore majoring in English and I have a strong interest in volunteer work.
paragraphs.cn: 尊敬的先生或女士：我写信是想咨询贵网站提到的“援助农村小学”项目。我是英语专业大二学生，对志愿服务有浓厚兴趣。
keys: I am writing to inquire about

paragraphs.en: I would like to know what volunteers are expected to do, how long the project lasts, and whether any training will be provided before we set off. I would also like to know whether accommodation and meals are covered.
paragraphs.cn: 我想了解志愿者需要做什么、项目持续多久，以及出发前是否会提供培训。我还想了解是否提供食宿。
keys: I would like to know what / how long / whether

paragraphs.en: I would be grateful if you could send me the details. Thank you for your time. I am looking forward to your early reply. I would appreciate it if you could reply at your earliest convenience. Yours sincerely, Li Ming.
paragraphs.cn: 如能告知详情，我将不胜感激。感谢您的时间。期待您的早日回复。如能尽早回复，我将不胜感激。你真诚的，李明。
keys: I would be grateful if you could

blanks.en: I am writing to ____ about the "Aiding Rural Primary School" project ____ on your website.
I would like to know what volunteers are ____ to do, how long the project ____, and whether any ____ will be provided before we set off.
I would be ____ if you could send me the ____.

transfer: I am writing to inquire about… 换成 apply for… 即求职或申请信
I would like to know what / how long / whether 三连问，条理清晰
I would be grateful if you could… 请求信息的礼貌说法

title: 大作文 1：柱状图静态对比
point: 大作文范文：静态柱状图的描述与归因
structure: 描述段：The column chart illustrates… As can be seen…
原因段：Several factors may explain… First / Second
结论段：In my view… It is advisable for…

paragraphs.en: The column chart illustrates how residents of a certain city prefer to exercise. As can be seen, exercising alone accounts for 54.3%, followed by exercising with friends at 47.7%, while exercising with family and in groups make up 23.9% and 15.8% respectively. Overall, individual exercise is far more popular than group activities.
paragraphs.cn: 该柱状图展示了某市居民偏好的锻炼方式。可以看出，独自锻炼占 54.3%，与朋友一起锻炼占 47.7%，而与家人一起和参加团体活动的比例分别为 23.9% 和 15.8%。总体来看，独自锻炼远比团体活动受欢迎。

paragraphs.en: Several factors may explain this pattern. First, exercising alone gives people the freedom to arrange their own schedule. Second, the desire for communication encourages many to work out with friends. Group activities, by contrast, require fixed time and space, which few people can afford. In addition, busy schedules leave many people little time for organized sports.
paragraphs.cn: 这一格局可由几个因素解释。首先，独自锻炼让人可以自由安排时间。其次，交流的愿望促使许多人选择与朋友一起运动。相比之下，团体活动需要固定的时间和场地，很少有人能长期满足。此外，繁忙的日程让很多人几乎没有时间参加有组织的运动。
keys: by contrast, require…, which few people can afford

paragraphs.en: In my view, this trend is likely to continue. It is therefore advisable for the government to build more public sports facilities so that group exercise becomes more convenient. Only in this way can exercise become a regular part of daily life for more citizens.
paragraphs.cn: 在我看来，这一趋势很可能会延续。因此，政府宜建设更多公共体育设施，让团体锻炼更便利。只有这样，锻炼才能成为更多市民日常生活的一部分。
keys: this trend is likely to continue
It is advisable for the government to

blanks.en: The column chart ____ how residents of a certain city prefer to exercise. As can be seen, exercising alone ____ for 54.3%, ____ by exercising with friends at 47.7%.
Several factors may ____ this pattern. First, exercising alone gives people the ____ to arrange their own schedule. Group activities, by ____, require fixed time and space.
In my view, this trend is ____ to continue. It is therefore ____ for the government to build more public sports facilities.

transfer: The column chart illustrates… 换成 The pie chart reveals… / The line graph traces…
accounts for X%, followed by Y% 描述占比与排序的万能句
It is advisable for … to … 建议类收尾，图表作文通用

title: 大作文 2：柱状图两年升降
point: 大作文范文：两组年份的升降对比
structure: 描述段：compares … in 2013 and 2018 / while…
原因段：On the one hand / On the other hand
结论段：In conclusion… promises…

paragraphs.en: The column chart compares the choices of graduates in a certain university in 2013 and 2018. The proportion of those finding a job dropped from 68.1% to 60.7%, while the share of those pursuing further study rose by about one third and that of start-ups doubled. Obviously, the job market has become far more demanding than before.
paragraphs.cn: 该柱状图对比了某高校 2013 年与 2018 年毕业生的去向。选择就业的比例从 68.1% 降至 60.7%，而继续深造的比例上升约三分之一，创业比例翻了一番。显然，就业市场比以往要求更高。

paragraphs.en: Two factors stand out. On the one hand, a competitive job market pushes students to improve their qualifications. On the other hand, the booming economy has lowered the cost of starting a business, making entrepreneurship more attractive. Moreover, young people today are more willing to take risks than previous generations.
paragraphs.cn: 有两个因素尤其突出。一方面，竞争激烈的就业市场促使学生提升学历。另一方面，经济的繁荣降低了创业成本，使创业更具吸引力。此外，如今年轻人比上一代更愿意承担风险。
keys: On the one hand / On the other hand
lowered the cost of starting a business

paragraphs.en: In conclusion, the number of graduates choosing further study or starting a business will probably keep growing, which promises a more dynamic society. Universities should therefore offer more career guidance to help graduates make wise choices. After all, the choices they make today will shape the future of the whole society.
paragraphs.cn: 总之，选择深造或创业的毕业生人数很可能会继续增加，这将带来一个更有活力的社会。因此，高校应提供更多职业指导，帮助毕业生做出明智选择。毕竟，他们今天的选择将塑造整个社会的未来。
keys: which promises a more dynamic society

blanks.en: The column chart ____ the choices of graduates in 2013 and 2018. The proportion of those finding a job ____ from 68.1% to 60.7%, while the share of those pursuing further study ____ by about one third.
Two factors ____ out. On the one hand, a ____ job market pushes students to improve their qualifications. On the other hand, the booming economy has ____ the cost of starting a business.
In conclusion, the number of graduates choosing further study will probably keep ____, which ____ a more dynamic society.

transfer: dropped from X to Y / rose by about one third 升降描述成对使用
On the one hand… On the other hand… 两面原因，避免单一归因
which promises a more dynamic society 结论段的正面拔高句

title: 大作文 3：柱状图单指标增长
point: 大作文范文：单指标增长型的写法
structure: 描述段：shows the rapid growth / climbed from… to…
原因段：First / Second / Third 三条并列
结论段：Such growth is expected to continue

paragraphs.en: The column chart shows the rapid growth of parcel delivery in China. The total volume climbed from 51 billion in 2018 to 83 billion in 2020, and the figure for rural areas rose from 12 billion to 30 billion over the same period. Such figures reflect the vitality of the digital economy in both cities and the countryside.
paragraphs.cn: 该柱状图显示了中国快递业务的快速增长。全国业务量从 2018 年的 510 亿件升至 2020 年的 830 亿件，同期农村地区的数字从 120 亿件升至 300 亿件。这些数字反映出城乡数字经济的活力。

paragraphs.en: This boom can be attributed to three factors. First, rising incomes have enabled people to buy more goods online. Second, online shopping removes the limits of distance and time. Third, government support for e-commerce has helped delivery companies expand quickly. In short, the boom is the result of growing demand and better infrastructure.
paragraphs.cn: 这一增长可归因于三个因素。首先，收入提高使人们能在网上购买更多商品。其次，网购打破了距离与时间的限制。第三，政府对电子商务的支持帮助快递公司迅速扩张。简言之，这一繁荣源于需求增长与基础设施改善。
keys: can be attributed to three factors
removes the limits of distance and time

paragraphs.en: Such growth is expected to continue in the years ahead, bringing convenience to more families while placing higher demands on the industry. Meanwhile, delivery companies should pay more attention to packaging waste and the rights of their workers so that the industry can grow in a healthy way.
paragraphs.cn: 这一增长在未来几年预计仍将持续，在给更多家庭带来便利的同时，也对行业提出了更高要求。与此同时，快递企业应更重视包装浪费与员工权益，让行业健康发展。

blanks.en: The column chart shows the ____ growth of parcel delivery in China. The total volume ____ from 51 billion in 2018 to 83 billion in 2020.
This boom can be ____ to three factors. First, rising incomes have ____ people to buy more goods online. Second, online shopping removes the ____ of distance and time.
Such growth is ____ to continue in the years ahead, ____ convenience to more families.

transfer: climbed from … to … 单指标增长的描述句
can be attributed to three factors 引出并列原因
while placing higher demands on… 利与弊同句的收尾方式

title: 大作文 4：饼状图占比排序
point: 大作文范文：饼图的占比与排序描述
structure: 描述段：reveals why… / takes the largest share
原因段：is not surprising / ranks second because
结论段：will keep growing / should be encouraged

paragraphs.en: The pie chart reveals why college students read on their smartphones. Reading for study takes the largest share at 59.5%, followed by entertainment at 21.3%, while getting information accounts for 17.0% and other purposes only 2.2%. It is clear that study remains the primary purpose of mobile reading among students.
paragraphs.cn: 该饼状图揭示了大学生用手机阅读的原因。为学习而阅读占比最大，达 59.5%，其次是为娱乐，占 21.3%，获取信息占 17.0%，其他目的仅占 2.2%。可见，学习仍是学生手机阅读的首要目的。

paragraphs.en: The dominance of study reading is not surprising. Smartphones make it possible to review notes anywhere, and free learning apps have greatly reduced the cost of access. Entertainment ranks second because short videos and novels offer quick relief from academic pressure. Besides, reading on the phone saves the trouble of carrying heavy books.
paragraphs.cn: 学习类阅读占主导并不意外。手机让随处复习笔记成为可能，免费学习应用也大幅降低了获取知识的成本。娱乐排在第二，是因为短视频和小说能快速缓解学业压力。此外，手机阅读省去了携带厚重书本的麻烦。

paragraphs.en: In my opinion, mobile reading will keep growing, and students should be encouraged to use it in a purposeful way. Schools and parents should also guide students to keep a balance between study and entertainment. With proper guidance, mobile reading can truly benefit their growth. This trend deserves our attention.
paragraphs.cn: 在我看来，手机阅读会继续增长，也应鼓励学生有目的地使用它。学校和家长也应引导学生平衡学习与娱乐。在正确引导下，手机阅读才能真正助力学生成长。这一趋势值得关注。

blanks.en: The pie chart ____ why college students read on their smartphones. Reading for study takes the largest ____ at 59.5%, ____ by entertainment at 21.3%.
The ____ of study reading is not surprising. Free learning apps have greatly ____ the cost of access. Entertainment ranks second because short videos offer quick ____ from academic pressure.
In my opinion, mobile reading will keep ____, and students should be encouraged to use it in a ____ way.

transfer: takes the largest share at X%, followed by Y% 饼图排序描述
is not surprising / ranks second because 归因句式
in a purposeful way 建议类状语，替换 properly / correctly

title: 大作文 5：折线图持续上升
point: 大作文范文：折线图的趋势描述
structure: 描述段：traces … from 2012 to 2021 / rose steadily
原因段：Several reasons account for / First / Second / Third
结论段：likely to continue / contribute to

paragraphs.en: The line graph traces the health literacy level of Chinese residents from 2012 to 2021. The percentage rose steadily from about 8.8% to 25.4%, with no obvious decline in any year. This steady rise indicates that health has become a growing concern for ordinary people.
paragraphs.cn: 该折线图追踪了 2012 至 2021 年中国居民的健康素养水平。这一比例从约 8.8% 稳步上升到 25.4%，期间没有任何一年出现明显下降。这一稳步上升说明健康日益受到普通人的关注。
keys: rose steadily, with no obvious decline

paragraphs.en: Several reasons account for the improvement. First, public campaigns have made health knowledge more accessible. Second, the growing use of the internet enables people to obtain medical information quickly. Third, better education has helped citizens judge that information critically. Finally, the improvement of medical services has given people easier access to reliable advice.
paragraphs.cn: 这一改善有几个原因。首先，公共宣传活动让健康知识更易获得。其次，互联网的普及使人们能迅速获取医疗信息。第三，教育水平的提升帮助公众批判性地判断这些信息。最后，医疗服务的改善让人们更容易获得可靠建议。

paragraphs.en: This upward trend is likely to continue, and it will contribute to a healthier and more productive society. To maintain this momentum, the government should keep investing in health education, especially in rural areas. A healthy population, in turn, will bring lasting benefits to the economy and to every family. Such progress is encouraging.
paragraphs.cn: 这一上升趋势很可能会延续，并将推动社会更健康、更有生产力。为保持这一势头，政府应持续投入健康教育，尤其是农村地区。而健康的人口反过来会给经济和每个家庭带来长远收益。这样的进步令人鼓舞。

blanks.en: The line graph ____ the health literacy level of Chinese residents from 2012 to 2021. The percentage rose ____ from about 8.8% to 25.4%, with no ____ decline in any year.
Several reasons ____ for the improvement. Public campaigns have made health knowledge more ____. Better education has helped citizens ____ that information critically.
This upward ____ is likely to continue, and it will ____ to a healthier and more productive society.

transfer: The line graph traces… from … to … 折线图开头，替换柱/饼图词即可
rose steadily, with no obvious decline 趋势平稳的修饰方式
contribute to a healthier and more productive society 影响类收尾

title: 大作文 6：表格多类别数据
point: 大作文范文：表格数据的比较与建议
structure: 描述段：The table presents a survey / receives the highest score
分析段：deserves attention / By contrast
建议段：should improve / so that…

paragraphs.en: The table presents a survey of employees' satisfaction in a company. Working environment receives the highest score at 4.5 out of 5, salary ranks second at 3.9, while promotion opportunities score only 3.1. The gap between the highest and the lowest score is rather wide, which deserves our attention.
paragraphs.cn: 该表格呈现了某公司员工满意度调查。工作环境得分最高，为 4.5 分（满分 5 分），薪酬以 3.9 分排第二，而晋升机会仅得 3.1 分。最高分与最低分之间差距较大，值得关注。
keys: receives the highest score, while… score only

paragraphs.en: The low score for promotion deserves attention. It suggests that employees see little room to grow, which may weaken their motivation. By contrast, a comfortable environment alone cannot keep talented staff in the long run. If this situation continues, talented employees may leave for better opportunities elsewhere.
paragraphs.cn: 晋升机会得分的低落值得关注。这说明员工看不到成长空间，可能削弱他们的积极性。相反，仅有舒适的环境无法长期留住优秀员工。如果这种情况持续，优秀员工可能会另谋高就。
keys: cannot keep talented staff in the long run

paragraphs.en: Therefore, the company should improve its promotion system and offer clearer career paths, so that satisfaction can be raised in a sustainable way. Regular surveys should also be conducted so that the company can respond to employees' needs in time. In this way, both the staff and the company will benefit in the long run.
paragraphs.cn: 因此，公司应完善晋升制度、提供更清晰的职业路径，从而以可持续的方式提升满意度。公司还应定期开展调查，以便及时回应员工需求。这样，员工与公司都能长期受益。

blanks.en: The table ____ a survey of employees' satisfaction. Working environment ____ the highest score at 4.5 out of 5, ____ promotion opportunities score only 3.1.

The low score for promotion ____ attention. It suggests that employees see little ____ to grow, which may weaken their ____. By contrast, a comfortable environment alone cannot keep talented staff in the long run.
Therefore, the company should improve its promotion system and offer clearer career ____, so that satisfaction can be raised in a ____ way.

transfer: The table presents a survey of… 表格题开头，替换 survey 内容即可
receives the highest score … while … score only 表格比较句
so that … can be raised in a sustainable way 建议类目的从句
